entities.summary: Riley Barber is a Canadian-American professional ice hockey forward who is currently playing under contract with ERC Ingolstadt of the Deutsche Eishockey Liga (DEL). Barber was selected by the Washington Capitals in the sixth round of the 2012 NHL Entry Draft. He is the son of former NHL player Don Barber.
